title: Camellia sinensis cream for medicinal use
intro: Camellia sinensis cream is a topical preparation made from the leaves of the Camellia sinensis plant, which is the same plant used to make green and black tea. This cream is often infused with extracts or oils from the leaves, giving it a rich, earthy scent and a slightly greenish hue. In herbalism, it is used to soothe skin irritations, reduce inflammation, and promote healing due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. It may also be applied to relieve muscle aches and improve skin texture. Some traditional practitioners use it as a natural alternative to commercial moisturizers and skincare products.
